`claude setup-token` is interactive and opens a browser login, so I can't run it for you. To run it in this session, type:

```
! claude setup-token
```

It prints a long-lived OAuth token (needs a Claude subscription). To use it with GitHub Actions, add that token as a repo secret named `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` under Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions. Don't paste the token into any file in the repo, since `.memory/` is tracked.

Both `/install-github-app` runs were cancelled. If you want the workflow file set up too, I can add `.github/workflows/claude.yml` once the secret is in place.
